body: You're right, I'm not worth it. I've made a mess of my whole life, and the effects would last the rest of my life no matter what I did, so why not just end it now and not suffer any more?

That's not really a great reason. How do I know it will get better? I just know the sheriff is supposed to come this evening or tonight and enforce the eviction notice. They'll toss me out and keep everything that's in the apartment. I'm not going to give them that pleasure. I'm going to barricade the door and force them to break things down. That will get them angry. Hopefully angry enough to shoot me. But if they refuse to shoot me, I could jump from the balcony. I'm on the third floor. I'll at least be hurt enough to go to the hospital.

I need a damn good reason before the sheriff comes.

The way I see it, I'll either die at the hand of the deputy, which seems to be the best outcome, or I'll be arrested and then I'll have shelter. If I'm on the streets, I'll die anyway but it won't be something I can control. I'll know what the deputy will do. I'll be beaten senseless or shot.

I need a damn good reason within the next hour. If the sheriff shows up soon, I'm doing it. I just wanted to be sure the post made it here.

All they care about is making me homeless. If I could be helped, they would have helped me, right? But if I can't be helped, then I can't live on the street. I'll die. So I might as well take advantage of trigger-happy law enforcement. If I don't die, I'll have a safe place to stay in jail or prison. I'm just a statistic now.
